args: Main menu: white text on light blue buttons (#5c9fef-ish on #72a5e5 bg) - low contrast, button barely distinguishable from background
Controls page 3 lists Debug cheat keys (F2-F6 spawn coins/wood/pawns) to every player; button row off-centre once Next disappears. 'Era box (tap)' on page 2 is vague - which box, tap with what?
Config: 'Chunk Size', 'Location Scale', 'Lag Prevention' are developer jargon with no explanation even on hover; low-contrast white-on-light-blue throughout; Back button same colour as background

Hovering disabled 'Plant Sapling' / 'Enter Settlement' gives no tooltip saying why it is disabled (needs saplings / be near a settlement). Also tip 'Got it' button moved from y=389 (tip 1, two lines) to y=376 (tip 2, one line) - the button jumps as tip text height changes

After clicking 'Create Nation' (66,517) the command bar reflows: the red 'Leave Nation' button now occupies the exact spot under the cursor, and the inventory panel jumps up. A double-click founds and immediately leaves the nation. Chronicle line truncated 'It is th...'
Pressed N, waited 8s, pressed L once: see whether the nation is gone without confirmation

Founding failure says 'Open ground lies about 150 to the south' (and earlier 'to the west') but the HUD has no compass or heading indicator, so a player cannot tell which way south is. Also the right column shifts: Season panel top at y=300 in Forest (3-line wrapped region text) vs y=317 in Plains; bright 'Craft Pickaxe' button washes out over a yellow block

#350 confirmed: inside own settlement the right column overflows. Settlement Info 'Next (K): Farm, 25 wood, 10' is clipped at the screen edge (stone count/unit lost). Season panel (y~432) overlaps Player Info: 'LEADER' and 'Land: your own land' peek out underneath/below it at the bottom edge; Energy bar hidden. 'PCIS: 0' is unexplained jargon. Disabled buttons (Build Stall/House/Farm, Collect Stockpile) are white text on pale grey - nearly unreadable. A huge world-space label '0 here, 2/8 residents' renders behind the HUD

#345: when pawn Abigail walked into reach, a new row 'Talk to... / Gift... / Order...' was inserted into the command bar, pushing 'Send Caravan' from y=414 to y=383 - a click aimed at Send Caravan now lands on 'Talk to Abigail'. Same frame the Inventory Info panel jumped from the left edge (10,258) to mid-screen (220,227) over the world. Build Farm uses click-twice confirm (good); 'Talk to Abigail Evans (Stranger) - Greedy' is the widest button, labels near truncation

'Build Farm' button enabled though unaffordable (9 wood of 25). Clicking it then 'Confirm Build Farm' 3 times only ever re-arms ('Click again to confirm: Build Farm. (x3)') - the confirm click never builds nor reports the shortage. The K key path does report 'Need 2 more wood'. (Status says need 2 more while Inventory shows Wood 9 - stockpile must count, but nothing on screen says so.)

Objective 7 progress bar text clipped at the left: 'nbers 3/10 - Buildings 0/2' ('Members' cut). Market Info grew a 'Merchants:' list, pushing Season panel to y=466 so it runs off the bottom of the screen ('rich in stone, poor in' cut) and Player Info (energy, role) is completely off-screen. Era box 'Village: 1/4' text overlapped by the yellow fill bar

Nations screen (O): a single click on 'War' for Blackport declared war immediately (relation -13 -> -60, 'at war') with no confirmation, unlike Leave Nation / Build Farm which ask for a second click. Row then reflows (Ally+War removed, Peace appears mid-row). Also panel is a translucent overlay: text and buttons sit directly on the 3D scene, with the world-space '2 here, 3/8 residents' label showing through behind the tab bar; Ally button gives no hint it needs +30

Laws tab: small explanatory lines ('No tax: members keep their coin.') render as thin light text directly over the sandy plaza with no backing - low contrast; 'Defence 3.' appears with no explanation of what it means or what changes it

Inventory screen (I): plain white text drawn straight over the 3D well with no panel/backing - 'Apples: 26' sits on the blue/red well, hard to read; the screen shows less than the always-on HUD Inventory panel (no Chicken Meat line) so it adds nothing. Crafting screen (C) by contrast is clear, with good 'Ready / Need / Locked' colouring, but it repeats a stale status line about the Blackport war

#345 still present: pointer held still at (100,414) for ~18s. shots/shift1.png shows it hovering 'Talk to Charlotte Johnson (Stranger)' with 'Order/Appoint Charlotte' row above; shots/shift6.png (this one) the same pixel now hovers 'Talk to Abigail Evans (Stranger)', the Order/Appoint row vanished and 'Send Caravan' moved back to y=383. Pawn-targeted buttons change target and position with no player input, so a click can hit the wrong pawn or wrong action. Also: Charlotte (chronicle: 'joined Easternville') and Abigail (listed as our merchant) are still labelled '(Stranger)'

Tapping the Era box expands it (good content: checklist, unlocks, protection rules) but pushes the Objective panel down into the command bar: 'Send Caravan (Town era)' and 'Build Stall' are drawn over the objective's description text ('press K with wood and stone'), both unreadable. Expanded era '-' collapse affordance is a tiny glyph; 'Village 0/1' vs header 'Village: 1/4' is confusing (two different counts with the same label)

Command-bar confirm is fragile: first attempt at 'Declare War on Townfield' -> 'Confirm Declare War' -> second click at the same spot re-armed ('Click again to confirm... (x2)') because pawn Harriet walked into reach between clicks and a row was inserted; the stale orange 'Confirm Declare War' kept showing while the toast said something else. Retried with a still layout: two clicks 1.5s apart declared war ('Townfield takes up arms: war, 3 to your 3'). Same root cause likely behind the never-confirming 'Build Farm'. No Raid command appeared standing in Townfield's land at war (Land: Townfield (Hostile)); nothing tells the player how to raid

Entered Townfield's settlement right after declaring war on it: allowed, and Purchase Food/Sell Resources are offered as if at peace; no Raid command anywhere. Right column repeats #350 here: 'Next (K): Workshop, 15 wood,' clipped, and Season panel (y=432) overlaps Player Info, whose 'Role: LEADER' / 'Land: Townfield (Hostile)' lines show under and below it - the Hostile warning is the part that gets cut off. 'Next (K)' is shown for a settlement the player does not lead. A pawn's world label ('Katie / Ambit... (gath') is cut by the Settlement Info panel
Share screen: 'Export replay (USD)' - USD reads as US dollars to most players (it means the OpenUSD scene format); world-space settlement label bleeds through above the title
